derived_sources.rule: An invalid output predicts no label: it adds a false negative for its reference label and no false positive for any label. This matches accuracy, which counts invalid outputs as incorrect. Sealed stage metrics are not modified. Values are published only after the derived formula reproduces every stage F1 exactly on runs without invalid outputs.
